items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Johnny St. Sarah told me all the time.

ctx.x: When I started playing, when I played my first job, I was 16. I played with the Columbia Band up on Oak and Protection Levy at a place, a dance hall called Butcher Hill.
Oh, yeah. Johnny St. Sarah told me all the time.
Butcher Hill. Well, I played there with Columbia Band, Tick Chambers. I played in a fella's place. The drummer was with Tick Chambers by the name of Nene.
